cold-effectdesc:
I don't feel very well...

I'm much colder than usual, and my throat is sore.
I also have coughing fits.

A quick visit to the doctor wouldn't hurt.
diarrhea-effectdesc:
Your intestines are aching.
You have an incessant urge to go to the toilet.
A quick visit to the doctor wouldn't hurt.
foodpoisoning-effectdesc:
You seem to have eaten something not very fresh.
Your stomach is making strange noises, and you feel like vomiting.

A quick visit to the doctor wouldn't hurt.
brokenleg-left-effectdesc:
Your left leg is broken, and the pain is unbearable.
You should see a doctor as soon as possible.
brokenleg-right-effectdesc:
Your right leg is broken, and the pain is unbearable.
You should see a doctor as soon as possible.
reborn-effectdesc: You have recently died and are still suffering the consequences.
rabies-effectdesc:
Something is strange. Since the animal bite, you have been avoiding water. It brings you great fear. Along with this, you seem to suffer from irregular and uncontrollable spasms.

You should see a doctor urgently.
scurvy-effectdesc:
You feel constantly tired and weak.
Your gums bleed at the slightest touch, and your wounds take abnormally long to heal.
Your skin appears pale and marked with purplish spots.

A visit to the doctor would be wise.
bleeding-effectdesc:
It seems that you are bleeding.
Hurry up and bandage your wound, it would be a shame to bleed out.
infection-effectdesc:
Your wound is painful and appears to be festering with a strange yellow-green color.
A quick visit to the doctor wouldn't hurt.
d-blindness-effectdesc:
After spending so much time deep underground without seeing the light, even the slightest ray of sunlight burns your eyes.

You should take time to recover your vision.
Or perhaps return to the mines, even if it means losing your sight completely?
